confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bogota pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, and COP exchange-rate volatility adds uncertainty to all USD figures. FX: I could not open an rba.gov.au page to confirm an observation. A third-party site reported about 0.6947 USD per AUD for 2026-10-16, but that is unverified and is not supplied as the RBA observation, so the fx fields are null.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Andean and Latin American capitals with similar tourism and local-restaurant price levels (for example Medellin, Lima, and Mexico City), adjusted to Bogota's cost level. No single comparable city was used.
